Eric / team — couple implementation details from procurement/ops:
- Coupa's default is a single "acknowledgement" timestamp (48h). Your gateway's 24h expectation is common for immediate electronic systems. We can accommodate both by mapping two EDI events into separate Coupa fields: ACK_TS_PROVISIONAL and ACK_TS_FINAL. Our integration layer (middleware) will accept the 855 first-ack and populate ACK_TS_PROVISIONAL; when a subsequent 855 arrives we populate ACK_TS_FINAL and flip PO status to "Confirmed".
- I've attached a CSV of the proposed mapping/columns (EDI_ACK_mapping.csv). Please review columns ACK_CODE, COUPA_FIELD, and PROCESS_ACTION.
- Regarding COI: Coupa vendor profile supports an attachments slot plus structured fields: insurance_carrier, insurance_type, policy_number, policy_expiry. We'll require the COI upload to the attachments slot and policy fields to be set.

Operational ask for Clearwave: please push a sandbox 855 with a provisional ack and the carrier/policy fields in Coupa by EOD Tuesday (June 22). If you can't do provisional/final, we can accept single-ack but will need to lengthen the acceptance window to 48 hours and make the MSA language reflect that.

Markus Klein
Director, Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: EDI_ACK_mapping.csv (columns: ACK_CODE, COUPA_FIELD, PROCESS_ACTION)
